Compact Groundcar. Upgrades: TUp (MetalGear Coating [+3 SP]) Armored Chassis, Autopilot Terminal, Bulletproof Glass [x2], Bulwark Armor, Communications Center, CrystalDome, Heavy Chassis, Improved Engine, Sealed Environment, Smuggling Upgrade [x4], TUp (Automated) Vehicle Heavy Weapon Mount (w/ Remote Weapon System & Militech Mk. 31 HMG). Stock, the back carries 5 tons and 10 more riders who can't operate anything. Its weapon mount is a self-firing turret (like an Automated Turret) that shoots any threat; the driver or front passenger raises or lowers it as an Action (lowered, hidden and off), and a front passenger can fire it by hand.

Cost: 101,000eb
Nomad: 10
SDP: 80
SP: 18
MOVE: 20
Speed: 125 mph
